insights.title: Best model by ROC-AUC
insights.finding: Random Forest achieved ROC-AUC 0.741, F1 score 0.662, and recall 54.6% on the evaluation set.
insights.recommendation: Compare recall and precision at different classification thresholds before using predictions to prioritize operational interventions.
insights.limitation: These metrics describe the available historical dataset and do not guarantee future performance.

insights.title: Countries with high betweenness centrality
insights.finding: The top five countries by betweenness centrality in the current graph are: China, Netherlands, Spain, Japan, United Kingdom.
insights.recommendation: Inspect the trade connections around these countries and test how network connectivity changes when each node is removed.
insights.limitation: Betweenness measures structural position, not proven economic impact or disruption probability.

insights.title: Largest outgoing reported trade values
insights.finding: Countries with the largest summed outgoing trade values in the current graph include: China, USA, Germany, Netherlands, Japan.
insights.recommendation: Review the underlying edge list to identify important trade partners and determine whether particular products or regions have concentrated dependencies.
insights.limitation: The current graph may be incomplete because some API requests failed. Country-reported exports can also differ from partner-reported imports.

insights.title: Largest incoming reported trade values
insights.finding: Countries with the largest summed incoming trade values in the current graph include: USA, China, Germany, Areas, nes, Mexico.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the partners and product categories behind these flows before drawing conclusions about dependency or substitutability.
insights.limitation: Large incoming trade value alone does not establish that a country depends on a particular exporter.

insights.title: Validate trade-data coverage
insights.finding: The ingestion run reported failed country requests. The network therefore should be treated as a partial view until coverage has been checked.
insights.recommendation: Retry failed requests, record which countries were retrieved, and compare coverage before publishing country rankings as findings.
insights.limitation: Missing data can distort centrality and trade-value rankings; missing edges must not be treated as zero trade.
